mentions.heading: Changes in legal and business environments, including anti-corruption compliance
mentions.detail: FCPA exposure; acquired operations may lack compliance training; risk from JV partners and agents
mentions.quote: Compliance-related issues in certain countries associated with laws such as the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act and other anti-corruption laws could adversely affect our business.

mentions.heading: Changes in legal environment including trade, sanctions and climate laws
mentions.detail: Import/export controls, exchange controls, sanctions restrictions, greenhouse gas emission limits
mentions.quote: Changes that could impact the legal environment include new legislation, new regulations, new policies, investigations and legal proceedings, and new interpretations of existing legal rules and regulations, in particular, changes in import and export control laws or exchange control laws, additional restrictions on doing business in countries subject to sanctions, additional limitations on greenhouse gas emissions or other matters related to climate change and other changes in laws in countries where we operate or intend to operate.

mentions.heading: Changes in tax laws or tax rates and outcome of tax audits
mentions.detail: OBBBA enacted July 2025 extended TCJA provisions incl. R&D expensing; future changes could affect results
mentions.quote: On July 4, 2025, the U.S. government enacted tax legislation commonly referred to as the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (the “OBBBA”). The OBBBA made permanent or extended several provisions from the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017, including the restoration of expensing of domestic research and development expenditures.

drivers.name: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017

mentions.heading: Changes in tax laws or tax rates and outcome of tax audits
mentions.detail: Received assessments from various authorities, in appeals/litigation; company views some as arbitrary
mentions.quote: We have received tax assessments from various taxing authorities and are currently at varying stages of appeals and/or litigation regarding these matters. These audits may result in assessment of additional taxes that are resolved with the authorities or through the courts.

mentions.heading: We are subject to risks related to our international operations
mentions.detail: About 84% of 2025 net sales outside U.S.; facilities in Europe, Asia, Americas
mentions.quote: We have manufacturing and technical facilities in many regions, including Europe, Asia, and the Americas. For 2025, approximately 84% of our consolidated net sales were outside the U.S.

mentions.heading: We are subject to risks related to our international operations
mentions.detail: Exposure particularly to Euro, Korean Won and Chinese Renminbi
mentions.quote: Additionally, significant changes in currency exchange rates, particularly the Euro, Korean Won and Chinese Renminbi, could cause fluctuations in the reported results of our businesses’ operations that could negatively affect our results of operations.

mentions.heading: We are subject to risks related to our international operations
mentions.detail: U.S. holding company relies on distributions from non-U.S. subsidiaries; exchange controls could block conversion
mentions.quote: Because we are a U.S. holding company, one significant source of our funds is distributions from our non-U.S. subsidiaries.
